from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityMetric(BaseModel):
    """Institutional data extracted from one document for evaluating task criteria."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university in this document")
    total_undergraduate_enrollment: float | None = Field(description="Total undergraduate enrollment, Section B1")
    full_time_instructional_faculty: float | None = Field(description="Full-time instructional faculty count, Section I-1")
    reported_student_to_faculty_ratio: float | None = Field(description="Explicitly reported student-to-faculty ratio if available (e.g., 10.0 for 10:1)")
    six_year_graduation_rate_percentage: float | None = Field(description="Six-year graduation rate as a percentage (e.g., 85.0 for 85%)")
    graduation_rate_cohort_year: int | None = Field(description="The cohort year for the graduation rate (e.g., 2015)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregation of all extracted university metrics from the document collection."""
    university_metrics: list[UniversityMetric]
